commemorated_topic: 200th Anniversary of the The United States Declaration of Independence, 1776-1976
comments:
The American Revolution began in 1775, and this coin commemorates the 200th anniversary of the signing of the U.S. Declaration of Independence in 1776 (also known as the American Bicentennial), a widely celebrated event. All quarter dollars, half dollars, and dollars were struck with a special obverse for during 1975 and 1976, and were the first of America's "modern" circulating commemoratives, and are currently also the only circulating commemoratives to not to be part of a long multi-year series, then followed by the state quarters.

Of the coins without a mintmark, 376,000 were minted at the United States Bullion Depository, West Point. These coins are indistinguishable from the Philadelphia issue.
